ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Primary CTAs, section tags, active nav, the glowing product frame, hand-drawn annotations, and the single decorative rule on the left margin — the one warm voice in an otherwise cold palette

ember-glow.$description: Ember Glow — Gradient stop paired with Ember Orange for the rare gradient surface (e.g. template card accent bars)

glacier-blue.$description: Glacier Blue — Blue state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels.

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary text and lighter icon strokes on dark surfaces

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators.

slate-gray.$description: Slate Gray — Muted metadata text, timestamp labels, tertiary icon strokes

iron-border.$description: Iron Border — Hairline dividers, code block borders, subtle list separators

charcoal-edge.$description: Charcoal Edge — Card borders, subtle frame edges, input field borders

graphite.$description: Graphite — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Card surface — one step above canvas, used for testimonial cards and elevated blocks

onyx.$description: Onyx — Quote/testimonial card surface, link button background, the most common elevated surface

void.$description: Void — Page canvas — the dominant page background

black.$description: Black — Deepest surface for footer and image fill where absolute black is needed

geist.$description: Primary UI and display typeface. Weight 600 for headlines, 500 for nav and sub-labels, 400 for body. The tight negative tracking (-0.05em at 60px tightening to -0.03em at 16px) gives the type a machined, geometric feel — Geist's tall x-height and open apertures keep small body text readable against #040404 without weight inflation. Display sizes use lineHeight 1.0–1.14 for editorial compression.

geist-mono.$description: Code-adjacent micro-copy: version tags, branch labels, file paths, inline commit IDs. Only used at 13px / 400 with the same -0.03em tracking as body Geist — this consistency is what makes the mono feel native rather than a foreign insert.
